//: This site is plain static files with no build step.
Vercel special-cases a root folder named `public/`: with no explicit
config it treats that folder as the OUTPUT DIRECTORY and publishes its
CONTENTS at the site root. That deployed public/thumbs/x.jpg as /thumbs/x.jpg
and never deployed assets/ at all, because assets/ lives outside public/.
index.html asks for `assets/css/wii.css` and `public/thumbs/...`, so every
request 404'd and the page rendered as unstyled HTML.
Pinning outputDirectory to the repo root makes Vercel publish the tree
exactly as it is on disk, so the paths in index.html resolve the same way
live as they do locally. Do not remove this file.
